note: Physical acceptance state for the MIDI Brain hardware. An item moves to "accepted" only with measured evidence in docs/evidence/ that names a reviewer, a date and the current hardware fingerprint. The fingerprint covers the canonical PCB/panel sources, the mechanical TS-to-CAD bridge and its exported layout, the CAD algorithm, the JLCPCB order settings and the curated cable/hardware selection, so any hardware, algorithm, order-setting or part-selection change makes old evidence stale. Refresh hardware_fingerprint with `bun run scripts/release_gate.ts --fingerprint` after such a change; a documentation-only commit does not change it. There is no override key: unknown keys are errors. See docs/acceptance.md.

items.note: Measured board, standoff, display, Pi, HAT, cooler and panel thicknesses that add up to a stack, with the installed depth recorded.
Knob, button caps and the 5-way nav actuator fitted and measured against the panel: shaft, detent, cap height and direction legends.
TRS jack barrel, nut and panel-hole fit, tip/ring/sleeve continuity and pull-out retention measured on the sample.
Fitted Bivar PLP2-400-C length and LED-to-pipe gap measured; LED visible through each of the three panel holes.

Waveshare 4.3 inch DSI panel mounted on the front board at the fitted SMTSO boss pattern with one of the kit DSI cables (50 mm or 120 mm, 15-pin to 22-pin) routed, bend radius and latch verified, and the display underside clearance recorded.

The fitted display mounting confirmed on the physical module: the SMTSO-M2.5 bosses (99.30 x 61.80 pattern) take the spacer screws and the 58.00 x 49.04 plain holes do not, with the plane separation 9.0 mm = 4.0 mm boss projection + 5.0 mm spacer measured on the built stack.

The display FPC plug and the J5 IDC plug/ribbon coexist in the assembled stack: the provisional Z clearances (FPC stack top <= ~12.9 mm vs the front-board top face 19.05 mm and the IDC plug >= 19.05 mm) plus the routed bend at the display's right edge recorded per the route contract in docs/mechanical-stack.md.
The delivered display module label/SKU read and matched the selected part (Waveshare 4.3inch DSI LCD, ElectroKit 4103 5687) that the drawing and STEP model were sourced from.

With the display seated in the 107.22 x 68.87 panel window, touch input stays aligned with the visible UI: glass centred in the cutout and touch coordinates agree with the active-area silkscreen window.
microSD card inserted and removed with the Pi in the stack and the case closed; recorded clearance.
Active Cooler, M.2 HAT+ and NVMe SSD stacked and measured for height, airflow path and connector clearance.
32HP/3U panel, 20HP base board and every rail/standoff position fitted in the rack case at the recorded installed depth.
An exact 5 A rated panel feedthrough selected from a primary source (CAB-15455 is 3 A and rejected for this path) with the rating recorded.
Full-load PD negotiation, cable voltage droop and connector/feedthrough temperature measured in both orientations.
Bourns PEC11R process qualified: selective/wave soldering or a validated manual process with recorded profile and inspection.
Measured receiver threshold against the MIDI CA-033 <5 mA requirement at the recorded supply and temperature.

TLP2361 input current and junction temperature measured at worst-case high-rail/low-VF source corners, with the recorded ambient: recommended 2-6 mA, absolute continuous 10 mA at 25 C derated -0.13 mA/C above 110 C (8.05 mA at 125 C), and the 220 ohm choice justified by measurement.

Measure low-rail transmitter current into legacy receiver loads, rise/fall below 2 us and sustained ring/tip fault temperatures. The output topology and any deviation from the CA-033 reference need independent review; receiver threshold analysis alone cannot close this item.
Two real MIDI devices (not loopback) exchange note, clock and sysex traffic in both directions with the recorded equipment.
Short, open, reverse and over-current cases on both MIDI inputs and outputs measured against the protection parts.
Logic-analyser or scope capture of SPI0 clock/data and READY at the target rate, including the Pico USB and Pi-off cases.
Power-up and power-down order for Pi, Pico, display and 3.3 V rails captured with no backfeed or latch-up.
Closed-rack thermal soak at the recorded ambient and load, with cooler noise and NVMe temperature recorded.

With the assembly state recorded for each measurement (front board fitted or off, Pi fitted or removed, Pico socketed, Pico USB cable fitted or not), every rear-board probe point TP1-TP15 reached with the intended probe and read on the net the board declares; the pad, the side used, the assembly state and any obstruction recorded. In-rack access is not assumed.

Abrupt removal and re-application of power recorded on the full stack: rail decay order and time captured, Pico/Pi/display state, write integrity of the microSD card or NVMe SSD after a loss during a recording, and any backfeed or latch-up seen. No graceful-shutdown behaviour is assumed.
JLCPCB DFM/order-preview review of copper, mask, silkscreen, drill and CPL rotation on the engineering prototype material, with findings recorded.
The tscircuit warning 'Could not save autorouting paths' resolved, or its effect on the routed copper reviewed and recorded.
First-article boards built, inspected and tested against the acceptance list before any production order.
